limitations: The official questions and corpus parquet are locally verified; no corpus index or quality baseline has run.
The corpus exposes doc_id, source_type, title, and content only. Thread, participant, timestamp, version, freshness, project, and ACL fields must not be inferred as gold metadata.
The benchmark company and documents are synthetic, although designed to simulate realistic company-internal data.
The official answer leaderboard uses GPT-5.4 as a judge; any local deterministic retrieval score must be reported separately.
Four source IDs are reused by distinct official records. Internal record identity includes a raw-record hash; gold matching retains the official source ID.
Question qst_0413 contains one reused expected document ID twice. The adapter preserves the raw list and exposes an order-preserving unique view for explicitly set-based retrieval metrics.
